Faults:
No Track on Display,
No PD Count
Available.
Possible Cause:
Controls to Receiver
may be faulty.
Corrective action:
Check that LEDs D1, D2, D3
and ‘C’ (CLK) on all QDRs
are glowing. Otherwise
Replace QDR. Check that
Pin ‘69’ of J1 on ES Rack-1
is High.

Faults:
No Track on Display,
but PD Count
Available
Possible Cause:
Connection between
RIB and ESMP may be
faulty.
Corrective action:
Verify the Connection
between RIB and ESMP.
Check LED D5 on PPD-2 is
glowing.

Possible Cause:
Processor Boards
(ESMP-PPD3 or RIB)
may be faulty.
Corrective action:
Ping 192.168.5.90 (ESMP –
PPD3), 192.168.5.4 (RIB).If
any IP address is not
pinging, Replace the module.

Possible Cause:
DTOs in AHU-4 may be
Faulty.
Corrective action:
Check whether o/p of 2-18
GHz DTO and 0.5-2GHz
DTO in AHU-4 are OK or
NOT OK.

Reload Phase Data in QDR.
If Still problem exists,
Replace QDR.

Possible Cause:
Synthesizer in BB and
NB RX AHU may be
faulty.
Corrective action:
Check that LO i/p at QSHR
is correct. If any problem
found, Replace Synthesizer.

Possible Cause:
Any module in LVPS-1
may be faulty.
Corrective action:
Observe the LEDS PS5 to
PS11on LVPS-1. If any LED
is not glowing the
corresponding output voltage
is NOT OK. Replace the
power supply module.
